Get the trait values of a database with their units

Source: R/get_trait_values_by_version.R
get_trait_values_by_version.Rd

Build a lazy table of the trait values of a VegVault database. For VegVault 2.0.0 or newer, it adds the unit of each trait and the keys of the unit-conversion and derivation rules of each value.

Usage

get_trait_values_by_version(db_con)

Arguments

db_con

A valid DBI connection to a VegVault SQLite database.

Value

A lazy table (tbl_sql) of TraitsValue. For VegVault 2.0.0 or newer it has the extra columns conversion_rule_key, derivation_rule_key and trait_unit; for VegVault 1 it has the columns of the table as stored.

Details

The version is read by is_vegvault_v2(). For VegVault 2.0.0 or newer, the tables TraitUnitConversion, TraitDerivation, Traits and TraitsDomain must exist, otherwise the function stops with an error. The rule keys and units are added with left joins, so a value without a conversion or derivation rule is kept, with a missing key.

See also

is_vegvault_v2(), get_traits()
